## Activity

During July 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 114 captures. Activity proceeded as expected, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity reflects the work completed by the clinic team during the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 114 captures completed, 3 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.6. The result will continue to be monitored through routine review of image capture and local operating arrangements. No further operational issue was identified in relation to the session lists during the reporting period.

## Grading

Grading identified 15 referable results from the captures completed in July 2020. The median lag from image capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading activity was completed within the expected operational timeframe for the month. The referable results should be managed through the usual clinical pathway, with appropriate follow-up arranged in accordance with local procedures. Overall, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a concise record of site operations for July 2020.
